title: The Day of the Locked Drawer
skyStory: The waning gibbous moon, ninety-four percent lit, slips into Scorpio, the sign of secrets, keys and deep water. Pluto hands it a ring of old brass keys and points toward a drawer nobody has opened since autumn. The moon jingles the keys thoughtfully. Some drawers hold treasure. Some hold three dried-out pens and a mystery button. Either way, today it gets opened.

reading: Scorpio moons love a mystery, and there is one hiding in your space right now: a box, a folder, a drawer you have avoided because you are not sure what is inside. Today, open it. Spend no more than twenty minutes in there.

You will find one thing worth keeping, one thing worth tossing, and one thing that makes you laugh out loud. The laugh is the real treasure. The Tiger was expecting dread and found a forgotten note, a funny photo, or a gadget whose purpose is lost to history. Keep that one on your desk for a week as a reminder that the scary drawer was never scary.
joel.mission: Open the drawer or box you have been avoiding, give it twenty minutes, and keep the funniest thing you find.
joel.omen: An old key with no known lock. It means something you thought was closed is quietly ready to open.

reading: Scorpio is a detective sign, and the Wood Rat is a natural sleuth. Today you will notice a clue that everyone else has missed: a typo in a document, a pattern in a schedule, a quiet person who needs a hand. Say something. Your eye is sharp as a needle today.

In the evening, a memory surfaces of something you meant to do last autumn and let slip. Do not treat it as guilt. Treat it as a treasure map. The [[Page of Swords]] arrives with a magnifying glass and a pencil behind her ear, asking which clue you would like to follow next. Pick the most fun one. Start tomorrow.
nancy.mission: Spot one mistake or overlooked detail today that nobody else noticed, and point it out kindly and cleverly.
nancy.omen: A magnifying glass, a lens or a reflection showing something hidden. It means your detective instincts are switched on.

together.text: Scorpio treasure hunt. Each of you open one neglected drawer and send the other a description of the strangest thing inside, without naming it. The other must guess what it is in three tries. Prizes are purely imaginary.

game.intro: Something is in the locked drawer. Show only a sliver of it. Saturn loves a mystery.
game.prompt: Something from the back of a drawer you rarely open. Zoom in until it becomes a riddle.
